en.question: If <<7010>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11953>>, so that the targeted "Fluffal" Monster in your Graveyard is no longer in the Graveyard, how does this resolve?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、対象のモンスターを除外する事ができませんので、「<<11953>>」の効果処理は適用されません。
